groups.sentence: Instructors do not design assessments or teaching to police student behavior; the aim is student growth and learning.
Policing AI use and using AI detectors harms trust and the relationship between students and instructors.
Instructors will increasingly need to trust students to follow AI policies voluntarily, because prohibitions cannot be enforced.
Instructors help students develop AI literacy and responsible use rather than police and penalize AI use.
Instructors do not adopt intensive surveillance tools or over-prioritize catching and preventing AI cheating.
Administrators ensure students do not feel policed.
Clarity and ongoing dialogue are more effective than policing.
